data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German Frid, meaning 'peace', and the suffix -er, meaning 'warrior'. The name Frieder reflects a peaceful warrior, a protector who brings calm and tranquility. The name Frieder carries the meaning “Peaceful warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frieder usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
